text:
Alex: Hey folks — I pushed updates for PR #1234. Addressed the review comments about backpressure handling, factored the retry logic into cache/retry_helper.go, and added an integration test that exercises the full request path. Also added a small changelog entry under "Bugfixes". CI is green for unit tests but one e2e job is flaky (investigating). PTAL when you have a minute; aiming to merge during Friday's 14:00-15:00 PT merge window.

Priya: Thanks — will take a look in ~30 mins.

Sam: quick Q — does the retry helper change the default retry count/timeout? we rely on that in some internal infra tests.

Alex: good call — behavior preserved (defaults still 3 retries, 200ms backoff). I added an optional config param so Dedicated customers can override.

Maya: CI shows the flaky e2e is the 'session-reconnect' test. can we mark it flaky and open a follow-up to stabilize? not blocking merge if we add the flake tag and note in the changelog. :thinking_face: 

Alex: I added a `[flake]` tag to that test and created a follow-up issue (RFC-872) with details. Rerunning full CI now.

ci-bot: CircleCI job #5421: unit-tests ✅, integration-tests ✅, e2e/session-reconnect — rerun queued.

Jordan: lgtm from me on the code. Maya / Priya want to be the final approvers for merge orchestration?

Maya: I'll give final sign-off once CI finishes the rerun. no objections to skipping the flaky test for now. :+1:

Priya: scanning the integration test briefly — looks good, coverage looks fine. lgtm.

Alex: thanks all. CI passed on rerun (all checks green). I'll merge during the Friday 14:00 PT slot and kick off a canary deploy to dedicated infra. If anything unexpected pops up I'll rollback and post in #incidents.

Jordan: sounds good. thanks for handling the follow-ups and the changelog note.

Alex: np — appreciate the quick eyes!
